Quantum 1.31.0 was certified on 2026-09-11. It pins **nucleus v1.27.0**, **quark v1.14.0** and **orbit v1.9.5**, with 23 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.30.0: nucleus goes from v1.26.0 to v1.27.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.13.0 to v1.14.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.9.4 to v1.9.5 (patch). 22 sibling modules change version.
